title: HTTP Gateway
description: Manage reverse proxies, HTTP policies and explicit traffic interception.
gatewayDirectoryHelp: Choose a Gateway to edit its settings and traffic.
selectGatewayHelp: Choose one from the list to edit its settings.
resetStatisticsWarning: Clear the saved request counters for this Gateway? This cannot be undone.
resetAllStatisticsWarning: Clear the saved request counters for all Gateways? This cannot be undone.
name: Name
listenHelp: Leave empty for interception only. Public listeners require source CIDRs. Forwarding to an original destination is available only on admitted intercepted streams.
keyFile: Private key file on the backend
debugLoggingHelp: After you save and activate, request summaries appear in Config → Logs. They include method, path, status, body byte counts and duration. Query strings, headers and body contents are not logged.
createRulesFirst: Create HTTP rules, then select them here.
priorityHelp: Lower numbers match first. Equal priorities use rule ID order. The first matching enabled rule wins.
selectRuleHelp: Select a rule to edit, or add an HTTP rule.
selectFilterHelp: Select a filter list to edit, or add one.
selectPoolHelp: Select a backend pool to edit. Choose a Reverse proxy action with no pool to add one.
streamIdleTimeoutHelp: Request timeout covers a full ordinary HTTP request, but only the response setup for SSE, WebSocket, and gRPC streams. Stream idle timeout resets with stream activity and closes inactive streams; 0 disables it. Pooled connection idle timeout never limits an active stream.
retries: Network retries for replayable idempotent requests (0–3)
mitmWarning: Installing and trusting this CA allows explicitly enabled HTTPS MITM to read decrypted HTTP traffic. Enable it only for traffic you are authorized to inspect. Installing the certificate does not enable interception by itself.
protocolLimits: GREASE ECH is handled as ordinary TLS. Real ECH inner names and requests are not decrypted; Gateway uses the visible outer name and clients may retry with ECH disabled. Certificate pinning, mutual TLS, non-HTTP TLS and HTTP/3 are outside MITM support. Exclude affected domains or choose passthrough. UDP/QUIC remains unchanged. A failed MITM handshake cannot fall back to passthrough.
interceptionHelp: Only explicitly selected TCP inbounds enter interception. TLS passthrough cannot match HTTP paths or headers. Generate a CA before enabling HTTPS MITM. Create a matching rule in the existing Routing page with action HTTP Gateway and choose this Gateway. Interception settings only authorize handling after that routing action matches.
filterHelp: Supported: ||example.com/ads/* and @@||example.com/ads/allowed. Domain rules and trailing anchors are supported. Options ($...), cosmetic rules (##), scriptlets and unanchored regex are rejected and counted.
createHttpListenerHelp: Listen on a port for HTTP traffic, including reverse proxy requests.
createTrafficInterceptionHelp: Handle traffic selected by Routing, without opening a separate listening port.
empty: No gateways configured. Existing TCP and UDP forwarding continues unchanged.
connectionsLink: Open existing Connections and traffic monitoring
testerHelp: Tests the saved running snapshot. Save and activate edited rules first. Test inputs are not forwarded to any upstream. Use an inbound ID to test interception; leave it blank for a reverse listener. Fill source IP and process when admission restricts them. Tests use the saved configuration. This tests the selected Gateway only; use the Routing tester to confirm the preceding Gateway action.
requiresMitm: HTTPS request parsing requires termination or MITM
subject: Subject
rotationWarning: Replacing the CA changes its fingerprint and trust identity. Clients must trust the new certificate; old cached leaf certificates are discarded. The CA private key is never available through this API.
importHelp: Choose a signing CA certificate and matching PKCS#8 private key. Import replaces the local CA. The private key is sent only to the authenticated management API and is never returned. Protect the management connection with TLS.
installation: Install and trust the public certificate
installationHelp: Install only the public root certificate on clients you control. Check the SHA-256 fingerprint before trusting it. The application never installs system trust automatically.
installWindows: Windows: import the certificate into Trusted Root Certification Authorities for the intended user or computer.
installMac: macOS: import in Keychain Access, then explicitly trust it for SSL.
installLinux: Linux: use your distribution’s local CA directory and trust update command. Browsers may use a separate certificate store.
installMobile: Android / iOS: install a user CA or profile in system settings, then enable full trust where required. Many applications do not trust user-installed CAs.
upstreamInUse: Remove references from Gateway actions and rules before deleting this upstream.
unifiedDescription: Configure traffic sources, HTTP policies, filters and backend pools together for each Gateway.
routeHandoffHelp: Routing selects the traffic sent to this Gateway, including Inbound conditions. Configure HTTP/TLS processing here. HTTPS MITM requires a trusted CA and an explicit domain allowlist.
backendPoolHelp: Choose Reverse proxy as an HTTP rule or fallback action, select Create a new backend pool, then add the pool below. The pool is attached to that action; other actions remain unchanged.
